_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 13 = formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): consolidacao 2 do Present Perfect (just/already/yet ao vivo + o par PP abre / past simple conta). listenings.text: Sophia, it is Ruby! I am at the stadium with my uncle, and it is crazy. The match has just started, and the fans have already sung the same chant five times. I have never seen so many people in one place. We are high up in the stands, so the players look tiny. Nobody has scored yet, but the referee has already shown a yellow card, after six minutes. Oh, and I have bought a scarf. It is red and black, so you are going to love it. I will send you a video at half-time!
